task.description: Produce test design artefacts for ADP-04a. Draft a test specification covering migration defaults, backward-compatible internal-user rows, uniqueness of (external_realm, external_id), realm+sub lookup behavior, and JIT provisioning linkage. Include concrete test cases for additive migration semantics, NULL handling, collision prevention, and tenant-isolation boundaries for identity resolution. Write the test spec under tests/specs/ and any required test scaffolding under tests/ per repository conventions. Design only; no implementation or test execution.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec covers all ADP-04a acceptance criteria and invariants
Migration/default/backfill behavior is testable with explicit cases
Lookup uniqueness and NULL-handling rules are asserted
Tenant-isolation collision boundaries are represented in tests
Output is ready for TEST-RUNNER without interpretation gaps

result.summary: Drafted the ADP-04a integration test specification covering migration defaults, NULL-handling compatibility, realm+sub uniqueness, tenant-isolation boundaries, and JIT provisioning linkage.
